cohort.fold: Reuse the frozen series-level fold in selection.pt; no row-level split or reassignment
cohort.outcome_blinding_note: A J-extreme subset had target errors read by the earlier temporal study, but neither the H<=32 filter nor this raw-vs-h probe comparison uses those outcomes
cohort.prior_diagnostic_exclusion: All 65536 series were excluded from the earlier target-weighted8192 information-access cohort
cohort.row_filter: Keep history_length between 3 and 32 inclusive before reading target labels or loading checkpoints
cohort.source_pool: The input-only 65536 one-context-per-series pool selected before outcome access by hard_lmm_instacart_balanced_v1

controls.constant: Opposite-fold label mean with zero input dimensions
controls.history_only64: Same valid slots as raw64, time coordinate one and quantity coordinate zero; isolates history length/position support
controls.same_capacity: raw64, h64, history_only64 and sham64 have the same 64 input dimensions and the same downstream family design size
controls.sham64: IID N(0,1) row features, seed20260906, independent of inputs and labels; procedural sanity only

input_boundary.first_boundary_gap: Include the first retained event delta_t because it is part of the frozen encoder input
input_boundary.h64: Final local encoder state at the last observed event before memory retrieval
input_boundary.history_order: Oldest observed event to latest observed event
input_boundary.observed_only: histories.pt contains only events strictly before the selected target; target gap and target quantity are absent
input_boundary.padding: Padding values must be zero and are never transformed or treated as observed
input_boundary.raw64: For each complete H<=32 history, right-align 32 event slots and interleave [log1p(delta_t),log1p(quantity)] per slot; unused left slots are exactly zero
input_boundary.target_access_barrier: Persist and hash the input-only H<=32 row identity, folds and raw64 before reading any selected target quantity or restoring a checkpoint

limitations: The flattened latest-aligned linear/fixed-random-feature probes are not an oracle for every sequence interaction.
Equal input and fitted design dimensions do not equalize the functional complexity that produced raw64 and h64.
Both frozen backbones trained on these train series and were selected using validation, so OOF probe results are conditional accessibility evidence rather than model generalization.
Positive raw64 superiority can still mix encoder compression, optimization, objective and readout accessibility; it does not prove literal information deletion.
Failure cannot establish irreducible noise, a defective dataset or impossibility of comprehensive improvement.
No architecture implementation, 5090 run, seed search, validation inference or held-out test follows automatically.

primary_decision.checkpoint_common_encoder_bottleneck: The complete three-reference condition must also pass for original in both families
primary_decision.comparison_cells: 2 checkpoints x 2 decoder families x raw64 versus each of constant,history_only64,h64 = 12 fixed cells
primary_decision.current_encoder_bottleneck: For separate_key, raw_signal and raw64>h64 must pass in both families
primary_decision.inconclusive: Any family, fold, bootstrap, body-direction or sham-guard disagreement withholds a bottleneck claim

paired_series_bootstrap.resampling: Resample one-context series within each frozen fold; use identical draws across all fixed cells; fixed OOF errors only

primary_decision.quantity_guard: A positive residual-MSE contrast fails if raw64 corrected body MAE is worse than the corresponding reference
primary_decision.raw_signal: raw64 must beat constant and history_only64 in both families
primary_decision.sham_guard: Invalidate a model/family interpretation if sham64 itself beats constant by the same 1%, fold and bootstrap conditions

probe.folding: Two-fold OOF; input standardization and fitting use only the opposite series fold
probe.linear: Float64 ridge minimizing SSE+1*sum(slopes^2), unpenalized opposite-fold target-mean intercept
probe.nonlinear: The same ridge on standardized input64 concatenated with 128 fixed tanh features; W~N(0,1/64), b~N(0,1), seed20260905

reporting.negative_wording: The bounded matched-capacity probes did not find accessible raw residual signal missing from h; this is not proof that the data contain no signal or that improvement is impossible

scope: Local frozen train-internal matched-capacity comparison of complete observed raw histories against Hard-LMM encoder h on Instacart series excluded from the earlier target-weighted8192 information-access cohort

targets.secondary: direct log1p(target_quantity), used only to describe whether raw history carries bounded-probe next-quantity signal
